import numpy as np
from collections import deque
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            minr = min(y for y,x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y,x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y,x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y,x in cells)
            objs.append((minc, minr, color, [(y-minr,x-minc) for y,x in cells], maxr-minr+1, maxc-minc+1))
    objs.sort(key=lambda o: (o[0], o[1]))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    r0 = c0 = 0
    for i, (_, _, color, cells, oh, ow) in enumerate(objs):
        for dy, dx in cells:
            y, x = r0+dy, c0+dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
        r0 += oh-1
        c0 += ow-1
    return out
'''
